svg.text: Low-fidelity wireframe of the shipped V3 layout at 1440 px wide (the 1366-class sizes apply below 1500 px: rail 76, top bar 60, gutter 24).

Every overlay floats on translucent grey glass with a solid fallback; its alpha keeps every text ink >= 4.5:1 over the darkest and lightest map pixel. The Now list is the accessible equivalent of the map.
